meta.name: Send a daily Sleeper NFL trending adds and drops digest to Discord

parameters.content:
## Sleeper — Daily Trends Digest

### How it works

This workflow produces a daily Sleeper fantasy football trends digest for Discord. It can be run manually for testing or automatically at 9 AM, then it fetches trending adds, trending drops, and active player metadata from Sleeper. A code node formats the collected data into a Discord-ready message, which is then sent to Discord.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger timezone and confirm the 9 AM run time matches the intended audience.
- Configure the Sleeper nodes with the correct sport/league or endpoint settings required for trending adds, trending drops, and player metadata.
- Set up Discord credentials or webhook/channel configuration on the Discord node so the digest posts to the correct server and channel.
- Test with the manual trigger to verify the Sleeper data, message formatting, and Discord delivery before relying on the scheduled run.

### Customization

Adjust the code node to change the number of players shown, the wording or formatting of the digest, and any filtering rules for adds or drops.

## Start daily run

Manual and scheduled triggers start the workflow, either on demand for testing or automatically every day at 9 AM.

## Fetch Sleeper trends

This central data-gathering cluster queries Sleeper for trending adds, trending drops, and the active player map needed to interpret player IDs in the trend results.

## Build Discord digest

Custom code combines the Sleeper responses and formats them into a digest message suitable for posting to Discord.

## Send Discord message

The final Discord node posts the generated trends digest to the configured Discord destination.

nodes.name: When Daily at 9 AM
nodes.notes: Runs at 9:00 AM in the workflow timezone. The workflow imports inactive.

nodes.name: Fetch Active Player Map
nodes.notes: Retrieves the active player map once per run for ID-to-name enrichment.

nodes.name: Compile Discord Digest
nodes.notes: Builds two compact Discord embed descriptions and prevents accidental @ mentions from player data.

nodes.name: Post Digest to Discord
nodes.notes: Create/select a Discord Webhook API credential here. The exported workflow intentionally contains no webhook URL or credential binding.
